correctness.rationale: The four Gaussian overlap integrals give the exact strictly positive prefactor times e^(-i phi)+r²e^(i phi)+2rc cosh u, with c=e^(-a²/sigma²), u=aT/sigma², phi=2pi a nu. For r=1 zeros obey cos v=c cosh u, |u|<=arcosh(1/c); the implicit gradient never vanishes and the level-set Hessian is -c cosh(u) I, proving smooth closed strict convexity. The exact integral I(c)=int_0^arcosh(1/c) arccos(c cosh u) du satisfies I′(c)=-pi/(2c), I(1)=0, hence I=pi/2 log(1/c), and the physical Jacobian yields area exactly 1. Independent quadrature checked c=0.1,0.4,0.8 to ~1e-15. For r≠1 imaginary part (r²-1) sin phi=0 forces odd phi pi; the positive cosh equation has exactly two solutions at ±arcosh((r+r^-1)/(2c)) and the nonzero Jacobian changes sign between them. All real T,nu and positive parameters covered analytically.
